{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: those with revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
filtered_df = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = filtered_df[filtered_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA orders)
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Number of QA orders removed: {len(qa_orders)}')
print(f'Number of completed orders (after removing QA): {len(completed_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}')"}
